Imagine everyone locks.

IMAGINE is live on Solana mainnet. Coins launch on Raydium LaunchLab, and their fees pay the holders who lock them.

Every curve trade, anywhere, pays a 0.5% on-chain fee to the coin's pool. Trades on imagine.fun pay 2%. 90% streams to lockers by weight, in whatever the coin is paired with: SOL, USDC, NVDAx, SPYx.

The creator earns nothing from fees, only by locking. No admin withdraw. Terms frozen per pool.

How it works, with the math, below.

imagine.fun

Imagine the chart if nobody sold.

On imagine.fun, coins launch on Raydium and holders can lock them to earn a share of every trade's fees, paid in whatever the coin is paired with: SOL, USDC, NVDAx, SPYx.

The chart on the homepage is a simulation, labelled illustrative. Drag the slider and watch.

imagine.fun

Launched on Raydium. Fees enforced on-chain.

Every curve trade on an IMAGINE coin, wherever it's made, pays a 0.5% on-chain trading fee to the coin's pool. Trades on imagine.fun add 1.5%: 2% to the pool. After graduation, the Raydium pool's fee share goes there too.

90% streams to lockers by weight, in the coin's pair. 10% treasury. The creator earns nothing from fees, only by locking.

How a lock's weight is set:

weight = amount × duration multiplier × size tier

4h 1.00× · 1d 1.14× · 7d 1.41× · 30d 1.86× · 90d 2.49× · 180d 3.11× · 365d 4.00×

Lock 0.1% of supply or more: +10%. 0.5%: +25%. 1%: +50%.

A year at 1% of supply: 4.00 × 1.5 = 6.00×.

Square-root curve, so short locks still count. Terms frozen per pool.

IMAGINE is live on Solana mainnet, and the code is public: github.com/realdoomsman/imagine

The tests run against the real mainnet builds of Raydium LaunchLab, CPMM and Token-2022, not mocks. A randomised test checks after every step that a pool can still pay everyone it owes.

On a mainnet fork we launched a SOL-paired and an SPYx-paired coin and ran buys, sells, locks, fee collection, claims and an early exit.

No external audit is published yet. Program, upgrade authority and platform config: imagine.fun/docs/security

Launching a coin on imagine.fun:

1. Name, ticker, image
2. Pick the pair: SOL, USDC, tokenized stocks like NVDAx and SPYx
3. Make your first buy and lock at least 10% of it
4. Sign once

One transaction creates the coin on Raydium LaunchLab, makes your buy and opens your founding lock. Nobody can lock before you do, and you earn nothing from fees, only from your lock.

Pool fee: 0.05 SOL.
